mission: To empower Africa's youth to generate evidence, shape policy, and develop innovative solutions to Africa's most pressing socio-economic challenges through research, human-centered design, and entrepreneurship.
vision: To build an Africa where empowered young people use evidence, innovation, and entrepreneurship to solve complex challenges, shape policies and drive inclusive and sustainable socio-economic transformation by 2050.
premise: By 2030, Africa will have the largest workforce in the world. We need to give youth the ability and capacity to solve African problems, thus empowering their future independence and self-reliance.

philosophy.title: The AfriYouth Core Philosophy
philosophy.formula: Think → Research → Design → Build → Influence → Scale

convergence.training: Most youth organizations focus on training.
convergence.policy: Most think tanks focus on research and policy.
convergence.clients: Most consulting firms focus on clients.
convergence.solution: AfriYouth connects all four into a unified African innovation and policy lab.

integratedApproach.title: The 5 Strategic Divisions
integratedApproach.subtitle: How our five specialized labs deliver cohesive, systemic transformation.
integratedApproach.description: Rather than running disconnected projects, AfriYouth operates five strategic divisions backed by a cross-cutting commercial service in Resource Mobilization & Partnerships.

pillars.title: 1. Research & Evidence Lab
pillars.description: Generates empirical data on Africa's emerging socio-economic challenges through applied policy research, youth surveys, baseline/endline studies, and political-economy analysis.
pillars.input: Grassroots data, youth lived experience & stakeholder diagnostics
pillars.output: AfriYouth Evidence Reports, policy briefs & open data syntheses

pillars.title: 2. Policy & Governance Lab
pillars.description: Translates empirical research into actionable policies, regulatory sandboxes, governance diagnostics, and statutory instruments that drive public-sector innovation.
pillars.input: Field evidence, legal comparative analysis & policy dialogues
pillars.output: AfriYouth Policy Solutions Series & Policy Innovation Challenges

pillars.title: 3. Innovation & Entrepreneurship Lab
pillars.description: Transforms community-driven ideas through human-centered design, prototyping, and market validation into high-survival, scalable ventures.
pillars.input: Grassroots innovators, validated prototypes & investor readiness
pillars.output: AfriYouth Innovation Accelerator (Incubation → Acceleration → Demo Day)

pillars.title: 4. Strategic Foresight & Futures Lab
pillars.description: Strongly differentiates AfriYouth through horizon scanning, PESTLE/STEEPV trend analysis, and 2030/2040/2050 scenarios to anticipate future-of-work dynamics.
pillars.input: Weak signals, emerging tech indicators & demographic forecasts
pillars.output: Africa 2050 Futures Series & anticipatory institutional strategies

pillars.title: 5. Leadership & Capacity Building Academy
pillars.description: Delivers mandatory experiential learning ('Learn → Practice → Apply → Receive feedback → Improve → Demonstrate') through real employability simulations and professional portfolios.
pillars.output: Employability Bootcamps, Professional Skills Academy & Impact Dashboard

flagshipAccelerator.title: Flagship: Evidence-to-Impact Accelerator
flagshipAccelerator.tagline: Combining research, incubation, policy translation, and scale into one 10-stage pipeline.

stages.name: Discover
stages.detail: Identify the problem through deep community research.

stages.name: Diagnose
stages.detail: Understand root causes using systems and political-economy analysis.

stages.name: Research
stages.detail: Generate and rigorously analyse empirical evidence.

stages.name: Design
stages.detail: Develop a human-centered solution with community co-creators.

stages.name: Prototype
stages.detail: Build and iterate the physical or digital solution in the field.

stages.name: Policy
stages.detail: Formulate policy recommendations and sustainable business cases.

stages.name: Finance
stages.detail: Connect the solution to funders, DFIs, and investment syndicates.

stages.name: Implement
stages.detail: Pilot the solution with institutional and municipal partners.

stages.name: Measure
stages.detail: Evaluate outcomes, longitudinal indicators, and real impact.

stages.name: Scale
stages.detail: Scale what works across national and continental borders.
